title: Universal Approximation of Measure-to-Measure Operators by Pushforwards
summary: Many learning tasks map an input distribution to an output distribution. A natural way to model such an operator is to transform each input sample using a continuous function that may depend on the entire input distribution, and then take the distribution of the transformed samples. This defines a measure-dependent pushforward model and includes measure-theoretic formulations of transformers.
